{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Eevee Evolution Lab |image=Eevee Evolution Lab.png |characters=イーブイ進化研究所 |japanese=Eievui Evolution Laboratory |imagesize=250px |region=Kanto |colorscheme=Galar |epicode=JN049 |episode=To Train, or Not to Train! }} The '''Eevee Evolution Lab''' (Japanese: '''イーブイ進化研究所''' ''{{tt|Eievui|Eevee}} Evolution Laboratory'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive research facility in [[Kanto]], located in [[Vermilion City]]. Headed by [[Pinery]], the Laboratory primarily studies an {{TP|Chloe|Eevee}} and its [[Eeveelution|evolved forms]]. In ''[[JN049|To Train, or Not to Train!]]'', the lab assistants were unsuccessfully attempting to get a female {{p|Eevee}} to [[Evolution|evolve]] under any conditions, including exposing her to a [[Fire Stone]] and then a [[Thunder Stone]]. Later, Eevee left the Laboratory after spotting [[Professor Cerise's Yamper]] outside. The lab assistants went after her, only to end up at [[Chloe]]'s [[Vermilion City school|school]] when Yamper thought they were out to get her for bad reasons. Once the confusion was cleared up, the lab assistants tried to return Eevee to the Laboratory, but the Pokémon decided to stay with Chloe instead. The facility features multiple laboratories and a large biodome area for the Pokémon to wander around. ==Staff== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} [[File:Eevee Evolution Lab Staff.png|thumb|250px|The laboratory staff]] The laboratory is initially composed of three known employees: * [[Pinery]] is a woman with straight blue hair who is the head of the Laboratory. After seeing the affection that Eevee had for [[Chloe]], she decided that the best place for the Pokémon was to stay with her. * Another is a '''girl''' with red hair and a streak in the shape of thunder, who is already a minor recurring character in ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'', being one of the Trainers battling {{p|Lugia}} in ''[[JN002|Legend? Go! Friends? Go!]]''. In ''[[JN049|To Train, or Not to Train!]]'', she and her research companion searched for the missing Eevee, but were mistaken for bandits by Chloe and [[Goh]]. * The third is a '''boy''' with brown hair. When Eevee disappeared, he went looking for the Evolution Pokémon with his research partner. ===On hand=== ====Girl with red hair==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Eevee Evolution Lab assistant |pkmn=Jolteon |type1=Electric |img=Eevee Evolution Lab assistant Jolteon.png |epnum=JN002 |epname=Legend? Go! Friends? Go! |vajp= |vaen= |desc=The female lab assistant with red hair has a {{p|Jolteon}} that she uses in battles. She used it alongside other Trainers in a [[Raid Battle (GO)#In animation|Raid Battle]] against a wild {{p|Lugia}}, but it was quickly blown away. It is not known whether this Jolteon is the same as the Jolteon seen at the Eevee Evolution Laboratory.
